eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Millard, UT; at 4:10 PM on JUL 31, 2026 Effective until 4:10 PM AUG 1, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Millard/Sheriff: Kanosh South of 300 S. is in SET status. Significant danger; voluntary evacuation in effect. Leave at any time if you feel unsafe. Stay alert and watch local news and cell phone alerts. Make sure your emergency kit is packed and ready to go by the door or in your car. Be ready to leave at a moment's notice. Confirm your plan with family and loved ones, and check on neighbors who may need help. Leave now if you can or if you feel unsafe. Shelter located in Fillmore at Stake Center.
